invariants.rationale: The method always returns a List, either the input or after sorting, and never returns null.
The method does not add or remove elements from the input list, so the output list always has the same size.
The method returns the same List object (either through early return or after in-place sorting); it never creates a new list.
If the result is non-empty, it is the same as the input records list after sorting; otherwise, for empty input, it's also the same list.
Trivial: covers all integer cases, may be filtered out as not meaningful.
